name: london-mystery-firestore-rules
description: Firestore security rules tests (Firestore emulator). Not part of the app.

scripts.test: sh scripts/with-jdk21.sh firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-london-mystery "mocha --timeout 20000 test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:sync: sh scripts/with-jdk21.sh firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-london-mystery "cd .. && flutter test --concurrency=1 test/sync_sender_test.dart test/sync_scheduler_test.dart test/sync_restore_test.dart test/case_files_test.dart"
scripts.test:sync-device: sh scripts/with-jdk21.sh firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project london-mystery-dev "cd .. && flutter test integration_test/sync_adapter_emulator_test.dart --flavor dev ${DEVICE:+-d $DEVICE}"
scripts.test:sync-app: sh scripts/with-jdk21.sh firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project london-mystery-dev "cd .. && flutter test integration_test/sync_app_e2e_test.dart --flavor dev --dart-define=LM_CLOUD_EMULATOR=${EMULATOR_HOST:-localhost} ${DEVICE:+-d $DEVICE}"
scripts.test:restore-app: sh scripts/with-jdk21.sh firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project london-mystery-dev "cd .. && flutter test integration_test/sync_restore_e2e_test.dart --flavor dev --dart-define=LM_CLOUD_EMULATOR=${EMULATOR_HOST:-localhost} ${DEVICE:+-d $DEVICE}"
scripts.test:case-files-app: sh scripts/with-jdk21.sh firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project london-mystery-dev "cd .. && flutter test integration_test/case_files_e2e_test.dart --flavor dev --dart-define=LM_CLOUD_EMULATOR=${EMULATOR_HOST:-localhost} ${DEVICE:+-d $DEVICE}"
